assemblies.name: Batch Belt Threading
assemblies.description: Routes belts through 4 axes (Y-Left, Y-Right, Z-Back, Z-Front) in one production-line session. Manual §7.1-7.5. X-Axis belt threading stays in assembly_d3d_x_axis_bench.
assemblies.learningFocus: Production-line belt routing: large→idler→small hole path, peg orientation (foot away from axis center, away from toothed side), first peg locked + second peg loose for frame tensioning.

partGroups.name: Batch Belt Threading (all 4 axes)
partGroups.description: Production-line belt routing: thread 4 belts through carriage→idler→carriage, lock first peg, leave second peg loose for frame-side tensioning. Manual §7.1-7.5.
partGroups.milestoneMessage: All four axis belts threaded; first pegs locked, second pegs loose for frame tensioning.

partGroups.name: Belt 1 (Y-Left)
partGroups.description: Route the Y-Left GT2 belt: large hole → idler bearing → small hole, lock first peg, second peg loose, travel test, label axis.
partGroups.milestoneMessage: Y-Left belt routed; first peg locked.

partGroups.name: Belt 2 (Y-Right)
partGroups.description: Route the Y-Right GT2 belt: large hole → idler bearing → small hole, lock first peg, second peg loose, travel test, label axis.
partGroups.milestoneMessage: Y-Right belt routed; first peg locked.

partGroups.name: Belt 3 (Z-Back)
partGroups.description: Route the Z-Back GT2 belt: large hole → idler bearing → small hole, lock first peg, second peg loose, travel test, label axis.
partGroups.milestoneMessage: Z-Back belt routed; first peg locked.

partGroups.name: Belt 4 (Z-Front)
partGroups.description: Route the Z-Front GT2 belt: large hole → idler bearing → small hole, lock first peg, second peg loose, travel test, label axis.
partGroups.milestoneMessage: Z-Front belt routed; first peg locked.

steps.name: Lay out 4 belt-pegs and route plan
steps.instructionText: Lay out the 4 GT2 belts (already routed through their motor holders from batch_motor_build) and 8 belt pegs. Confirm carriage belt-hole orientation: small ribbed hole beside large smooth hole on each carriage.

steps.name: Confirm belt route: carriage large → idler → carriage small
steps.instructionText: Mental walkthrough of each axis's belt route: insert one end through the LARGE smooth carriage hole, route around the idler bearing (slight curve helps), pull through the SMALL ribbed carriage hole. Belt-peg foot points away from axis center.

steps.name: QC: belt pegs and toothed-side orientation
steps.instructionText: Verify all 8 belt pegs have intact feet (no cracks). Toothed side of each belt must face INWARD toward the motor pulley throughout the route.

steps.name: Belt 1 (Y-Left): thread belt through large carriage hole
steps.instructionText: Insert one end of the Y-Left GT2 belt through the LARGER smooth belt hole on the carriage piece. Manual §7.1.

steps.name: Belt 1: route belt around idler bearing
steps.instructionText: Continue threading the belt around the bearing inside the idler. Pro tip: give a slight curve in the right direction before sliding inside the idler — eases routing. Manual §7.2.

steps.name: Belt 1: thread belt back through small ribbed hole
steps.instructionText: Pull the belt through the bearing and thread it back through the SMALLER ribbed belt hole on the carriage piece. Manual §7.2 cont.

steps.name: Belt 1: confirm peg orientation before lock
steps.instructionText: Position the first peg with its FOOT facing AWAY from the axis center, AWAY from the toothed side of the belt. Belt thread passes through the carriage before going through the peg foot. Manual §7.3.

steps.name: Belt 1: lock first belt peg
steps.instructionText: Insert the loose belt end ~¾ inch into the belt hole underneath the peg, then simultaneously press the peg into the small ribbed hole. Tighten the peg down. Manual §7.4.

steps.name: Belt 1: insert second peg LOOSE
steps.instructionText: Insert the second peg into the opposite carriage side, directly across from the first peg. Tighten the belt by pulling further through the first peg by hand. Leave the second peg LOOSE — it tightens after frame fitting. Manual §7.5.

steps.name: Belt 1: travel test (full rod-length glide)
steps.instructionText: Slide the carriage along the full rod length. Belt should track smoothly, no rub against plastic. If rubbing, re-seat the belt in the channel.

steps.name: Belt 1: label completed Y-Left axis
steps.instructionText: Use masking tape and a marker to label the assembled axis "Y-Left" and set it aside ready for frame mounting.
